rows.action: HB26-1325, Natural Medicine / Ibogaine research pilot program
rows.whatItPermits: Creates an Ibogaine research pilot program lane, allows up to five pilot sites, includes possible rulemaking around administration/manufacturing/use, and adds benefit-sharing language tied to Indigenous communities.
rows.whatItDoesNotPermit: Does not make unsupervised Ibogaine use lawful and should not be read as FDA approval, proof of efficacy, or a provider referral pathway.
